title: Countable-test criterion: convergence on a fixed countable family plus local mass bounds gives weak convergence in ℝ^P (Lemma CT)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. There is a sequence (ω_m)_{m∈ℕ} in 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with the following property. Let V_k ⊆ ℝ^P (k ∈ ℕ) be arbitrary sets, A_k ∈ 𝒟_n(V_k) (GeometricCurrentOn (V_k) n) and A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). Suppose that for every R ∈ ℕ there are k₀ ∈ ℕ and Γ ∈ [0, ∞) (Γ ≠ ∞) with M_{B_{R+1}(0)}(A) ≤ Γ and, for every k ≥ k₀, B_{R+1}(0) ⊆ V_k and M_{B_{R+1}(0)}(A_k) ≤ Γ. Suppose also that currentEval(A_k, ω_m) → A(ω_m) as k → ∞ for every m. Then A_k ⇀ A in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly As A), i.e. currentEval(A_k, ω) → A(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P). Here B_r(0) is the open ball, M_W = massOn (the supremum of ofReal(T(φ)) over test forms φ of the current's domain with tsupport φ ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm(φ(x)) ≤ 1 for all x), and currentEval(T, ω) = T(ω) if ω is a test form whose tsupport lies in the domain of T, and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∀ (Vs : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (As : (k : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Vs k) n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℕ, ∃ (k₀ : ℕ) (Γ : ℝ≥0∞), Γ ≠ ∞ ∧ A.massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → ball (0 : Euclid P) ((R : ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Vs k ∧ (As k).massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k => currentEval (As k) ((ωs m : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop (𝓝 (A (ωs m)))) → ConvergesWeakly As A
